question: Does the Queen counter (a19-queen-counter-v1) gain points on the owner's Queen setups without costing the default AI elsewhere?
origin: Owner, about the default AI's drafts: "They never pick tsar cannon, magic dragon, zena or anything to counterbalance me". The owner beats the AI with an Arachna Queen web: 4 of the owner's last 9 games against the AI fielded the Queen, and the AI won none of them.
rule: a19-queen-counter-v1: at the seat's level-4 pick, once the opposing Arachna Queen is visible to it (the live visibility: doctrine reveals and hidden-pick collisions), it takes Magic Dragon when Magic Dragon is offered; otherwise the live decider's choice stands. Measured through the research hook queen_visible (redraft candidate module and draft_guard.ts).

Screen (decision-rule-draft-hedge-replay.txt, sha256 a76e86e3...; development, the owner's 8 games x 32 seeds): an
unconditional level-4 hedge (Magic Dragon first) scored +0.20 points (95% -31.05 to +34.77): +73.4 on the Queen web
screen 3a611eda (18.8% -> 92.2%) and +71.9 on the Queen fort 1a785955, but -40 to -55 on three games without a Queen.
The narrower rule below was chosen after that result; the peer's matchup model (40,040 production games) also lists
Magic Dragon among the top counters of the Queen. QV is its test on fresh seeds and a held-out game.
Rule (a19-queen-counter-v1): at the seat's level-4 pick, once the opposing Arachna Queen is visible to it (the live
visibility: doctrine reveals and hidden-pick collisions), it takes Magic Dragon when Magic Dragon is offered; otherwise
the live decider's choice stands. Research hook queen_visible (redraft.ts candidate module and draft_guard.ts).
Part A, primary, the owner's exact setups: the two owner games where the rule fires, 3a611eda (in the screen) and
b2016809 (held out, played after the screen's games were chosen), 64 fresh seeds each (namespace
owner-replay-queen-confirm-20261124-v1). The AI seat re-drafts with the rule or the live decider against the owner's
real picks (redraft.ts); the owner's seat replays his real setup (life-run15 replay seat, real game ids); both seats
fight with the v29 bot-seat driver with deep fit. Estimate: the mean of the two games' differences, each game weighted
equally; 95% interval from 10,000 bootstrap resamples of seeds within each game (seed 2611243201), the two games fixed.
Part B, AI-vs-AI (draft_guard.ts, ai:iterate): visible-queen, 300 drafted families in which the candidate drafts as the
lower seat with Spymaster and the opponent takes the Arachna Queen at level 4 when offered (the population where the
rule can fire); mirror, 150 drafted families, the candidate on each side (300 cases). Plan seed 2611243201, plan sha256

Gates, all required:
QV1 part A: the estimate is above 0 and its 95% lower bound is above 0.
QV2 part B visible-queen: the estimate is at least 0.
QV3 part B mirror: the estimate is at least -2 points.
QV4 no more games with a quality error than production, in either part.
If every gate passes, the rule is adopted in the default draft decider as the next free A19 profile, at the owner's
request. A gain is claimed for the owner's Queen setups only. Not claimed: strength against people beyond those
setups; the owner's fight moves are played by the AI.
